name: Look-ahead pitfalls catalogued by Freqtrade (what to avoid)
one_line: Freqtrade's own examples of look-ahead: full-sample min/max normalisation, future-looking indicators.

source.license: GPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE). Only ideas are summarised here; no code copied.

idea: The folder holds strategies that deliberately contain look-ahead; the readme gives the solutions, e.g. normalize() with .min()/.max() over the full dataframe uses future data.
rationale: Recognise bias patterns before they reach the backtest.
limitations: do not import or run these strategies

pipeline_fit.notes: Use rolling/expanding windows only; any whole-series statistic is look-ahead.
